answer: Like a fable passed mouth to mouth, each epoch's public beacon publishes a fresh random seed, and every agent must relay a whisper token through three unrelated established agents within ten minutes, each hop signing with its own key and adding a small proof-of-work stamp. A Sybil farmer would need to control three genuinely established identities per fake account and coordinate them inside the window, costing far more than the reward, while an honest agent just taps forward once and pays almost nothing.
